hero_desc: Automated billing and credits management engine for MintForge. Experience Midjourney v6, SDXL, and FLUX with dedicated GPU speed.
pricing_subtitle: Select the ideal credit pack for your creative workflow
faq_a1: Credits are compute tokens used for AI image generations (SDXL = 2 credits, Midjourney = 5 credits, FLUX = 4 credits).
faq_a2: Top-up packs never expire. Monthly subscriptions allow rolling over up to 50% unused credits.
